name: PhD in Integrated Biomedical Sciences
institution: The University of Texas at San Antonio (UT Health San Antonio)
detailsNote: Official information available; the December 1 deadline is printed without a year, so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027. The $35,000 stipend has no year on the page. Whether students rotate or join a lab is not stated, so no admission model is shown.
summary: Integrated biomedical sciences PhD at the UT Health San Antonio Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences. GRE scores are not required, and tuition, fees and student health insurance are covered.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: The program page lists "Application Opens September 01" and "Application Deadline December 01" with no year.

timeline.interviews: Phone and Skype interviews are conducted for international applicants (also in January/February).

english.note: Academic IELTS. Scores must have been taken within two years of applying. International students who have completed formal training in a U.S. institution may request a waiver.

applicationFee.note: The page says a $50 nonrefundable administrative processing fee applies "for applicants that require Visa Sponsorship" (wording from the page, which dates it from 9/01/24). It does not mention fee waivers.

documents: Unofficial transcripts uploaded to the application (official transcript if accepted)
International transcripts translated by an accredited agency such as WES

funding.note: Students receive an annual stipend of $35,000 (the page gives no year). Tuition/fees and student health insurance are covered by the program. The pages do not say whether this covers international students.

international.note: The Graduate School says it values international applicants, though some timelines are shortened to allow time to process visas.
